<thought>Since the previous searches with functional‑group filters returned no results, I will simply search the template catalog for any retrosynthetic templates that can be applied to the representative product acrylic acid (SMILES C=CC(=O)O). This should return the template that corresponds to the Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons reaction.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=CC(=O)O",
    "limit": 10
}
</action_input>
